A finite steep tilt gives the strict off-center bound, and the isolated endpoint upper bounds are strictly below 5/8 at ε≤10^-4, checked by squaring the energy bound with rational arithmetic.

Any other L gives a strictly larger shift at Y; exact local strict growth and global monotonicity exclude it. Positive convex mixtures with one converge uniformly, and all tilted cap masses have the same threshold Lipschitz constant.
